scope: All original 37 entries mapped; implementation and source-level reconciliation, not live-store closure.

entries.original_issue: Text overlaps images, clips, or escapes section boundaries on mobile/tablet. Includes Basic Split Content and Split Content Dynamic.
entries.decision: Content-sized mobile columns; desktop split delayed to 990px in Split Banner. Preserve existing Folio Sub-banner layout fix.
entries.verification: Long copy/image-first/image-last at 390, 774, 1024; local browser checks.
entries.live_shopify_closure: Pending; no ULTIMA Shopify deployment in this pass

entries.original_issue: Product image lightbox lacks a visible close/exit button.
entries.decision: Close controls already exist. Classic now uses an opaque contrasting surface and both hosts have 44px minimum targets.
entries.verification: Classic/Modern commerce suites; live lightbox visual acceptance remains.
entries.live_shopify_closure: Pending; no ULTIMA Shopify deployment in this pass

entries.original_issue: “Select options” button and overlay styling need refinement and additional configurable appearances.
entries.decision: Solid, outline and ghost styles, button sizes, full-width and overlay placement already exist. No exact additional appearance is specified; retain as optional design enhancement.
entries.verification: Product card commerce interactions retain existing coverage; owner design choice remains optional.
entries.live_shopify_closure: Pending; no ULTIMA Shopify deployment in this pass

entries.original_issue: Too many menu links collide with search, account, cart, or logo before responsive navigation activates.
entries.decision: Retain VANTIER baseline breakpoint; measure actual navigation overflow for Header One/Two so long labels trigger compact navigation above that breakpoint.
entries.verification: Long labels at 1050px in actual rendered headers; Header Two lifecycle suite.
entries.live_shopify_closure: Pending; no ULTIMA Shopify deployment in this pass

entries.original_issue: Oversized logo or image stretches the header beyond its container.
entries.decision: Existing logo max width retained and constrained to the brand container; content-aware compact navigation limits crowded header rows.
entries.verification: Header Two rendering/lifecycle checks; real extreme logo/editor acceptance pending.
entries.live_shopify_closure: Pending; no ULTIMA Shopify deployment in this pass

entries.original_issue: Nested {% stylesheet %} inside Liquid conditions causes Shopify to reject product-recommend.liquid and dependent templates.
entries.decision: Stylesheet is at top level, outside Liquid conditions.
entries.verification: Theme Check zero errors at preceding checkpoint; final recheck recorded separately.
entries.live_shopify_closure: Pending; no ULTIMA Shopify deployment in this pass

entries.original_issue: Range values not matching schema steps cause silent template rejection. Automated pre-push validation is missing.
entries.decision: Validate explicit saved ranges recursively in templates, listing templates, section groups and current/preset settings using decimal arithmetic. Checked push wrapper stops before upload; CI validates on pushes and PRs. Direct CLI use can bypass wrapper.
entries.verification: All saved values pass; negative fixtures check wrong step, bounds and nonnumeric values.
entries.live_shopify_closure: Pending; no ULTIMA Shopify deployment in this pass

entries.original_issue: External SVG references fail across origins in Theme Editor. Icon sprite is also approximately 2.7 MB.
entries.decision: Rejected runtime cross-origin fetch of entire sprite. Generate bounded Liquid banks from all 6,831 symbols and emit only the requested SVG paths; no JS or external use reference. Source sprite excluded from upload.
entries.verification: Inline icon rendering and content component suites. All bank files generated from versioned library.
entries.live_shopify_closure: Pending; no ULTIMA Shopify deployment in this pass

entries.original_issue: Heading font settings don't consistently apply to native h1–h6 elements.
entries.decision: Global --qtm-font-heading already aliases font-head and native h1-h6 consume it. Inherited custom CSS conflicts handled in #10.
entries.verification: Source verification; actual merchant font loading remains a Shopify check.
entries.live_shopify_closure: Pending; no ULTIMA Shopify deployment in this pass

entries.original_issue: Custom CSS inherited through duplicated themes overrides font settings and introduces branding conflicts.
entries.decision: Archived ARC custom head/body code and cleared active default injections. Preset definitions already have empty injections. Native styles now govern ULTIMA defaults. Existing external store drafts are not changed.
entries.verification: Configuration inspection; ARC native design acceptance needed after removal of its overrides.
entries.live_shopify_closure: Pending; no ULTIMA Shopify deployment in this pass

entries.original_issue: Incorrect spacing conversions and full-width calculations cause clipped text and horizontal overflow.
entries.decision: Replaced 100vw/negative margins with parent width; use schema px values as px instead of dividing by 100 into rem; preserve content height.
entries.verification: Browser full-width/long-copy checks; spacing schema verified in code.
entries.live_shopify_closure: Pending; no ULTIMA Shopify deployment in this pass

entries.original_issue: Text-below layout has insufficient spacing; overlay gradient can make bottom-aligned text unreadable.
entries.decision: Ported card padding and flexible text area; strengthen bottom gradient and add a dark text scrim for white overlay copy.
entries.verification: Collection rendering suite; final visual acceptance with real imagery pending.
entries.live_shopify_closure: Pending; no ULTIMA Shopify deployment in this pass

entries.original_issue: Sort labels and action buttons wrap or become compressed at intermediate viewport widths.
entries.decision: Nonshrinking labels/buttons and bounded flexible select from VANTIER are present.
entries.verification: Collection hosts suite.
entries.live_shopify_closure: Pending; no ULTIMA Shopify deployment in this pass

entries.original_issue: Small component headings inherit oversized global h3 styles.
entries.decision: Use explicit component-scale heading sizes for inventory status and icon lists.
entries.verification: Source checks; inventory block suite included in final tests where available.
entries.live_shopify_closure: Pending; no ULTIMA Shopify deployment in this pass

entries.original_issue: lucide-* values display as text instead of rendering icons in some theme blocks.
entries.decision: Cards/tabs already route lucide names to q-icon; guarantee text icon now does so too. All use the new inline library while preserving literal text/emoji fallback.
entries.verification: Inline icon and content suites; only documented supported icon fields are covered.
entries.live_shopify_closure: Pending; no ULTIMA Shopify deployment in this pass

entries.original_issue: Wide mobile logo overlaps search/account controls at narrow viewport widths.
entries.decision: Mobile grid uses a zero-minimum center track; logo wrapper may shrink and image width is bounded by its own available space.
entries.verification: Wide-logo rendering at 320px verifies no overlap with actions.
entries.live_shopify_closure: Pending; no ULTIMA Shopify deployment in this pass

entries.original_issue: Image ratio control uses confusing/inverted width-to-height semantics.
entries.decision: Schema already explains width/height percentage and 125 = 1.25:1. Preserve saved values and existing aspect-ratio behavior.
entries.verification: Code verification; no inverted-value migration needed.
entries.live_shopify_closure: Pending; no ULTIMA Shopify deployment in this pass

entries.original_issue: Variant dropdown label presentation uses an undesirable em dash with pricing.
entries.decision: Variant option prices use parentheses; sold-out indicators retained.
entries.verification: Commerce CTA suites; no variant behavior change.
entries.live_shopify_closure: Pending; no ULTIMA Shopify deployment in this pass

entries.original_issue: Built-in marketing consent checkbox can duplicate an added consent field block.
entries.decision: An explicit required unconditional marketing-consent field suppresses automatic confirmation. Privacy consent is distinct and must not be silently treated as marketing permission. Use documented contact[consent_marketing] name. Live QA found the ARC homepage still had a redundant consent field: removed arc_64 from templates/index.json, retaining the required marketing_confirmation control.
entries.verification: Newsletter suite checks recognized consent and optional/conditional/privacy variants. Store configuration must use intended field identity.
entries.live_shopify_closure: Verified on ULTIMA QA homepage: exactly one marketing confirmation and no custom consent checkbox.

entries.original_issue: Desktop column rules override mobile styling, squeezing footer content into narrow columns.
entries.decision: Removed higher-specificity Department Hub desktop grid override.
entries.verification: 1/2/5 responsive-column browser checks.
entries.live_shopify_closure: Pending; no ULTIMA Shopify deployment in this pass

entries.original_issue: Active price filter chips display raw cents, e.g. Price:0–900000 instead of properly formatted currency.
entries.decision: Money formatting on both active-chip price bounds, including zero and open-ended range.
entries.verification: Local rendering tests for min-only/max-only/both.
entries.live_shopify_closure: Pending; no ULTIMA Shopify deployment in this pass

entries.original_issue: Mobile content overlays cover imagery; shared responsive layout requires correction.
entries.decision: Split media is positioned within its column; mobile content grows instead of covering the image.
entries.verification: Slide/fade and split/hero browser coverage.
entries.live_shopify_closure: Pending; no ULTIMA Shopify deployment in this pass

entries.original_issue: Buttons become white-on-white and unreadable on light hero panels.
entries.decision: Explicit text-color override; automatic black/white selection for solid panels; image backgrounds retain explicit merchant control.
entries.verification: Multipurpose suite; real image and hover contrast acceptance pending.
entries.live_shopify_closure: Pending; no ULTIMA Shopify deployment in this pass

entries.original_issue: Missing independent merchant-configurable text-color controls. An approved fix was reused in ORVAINE.
entries.decision: Independent text/label color controls are present.
entries.verification: Services/stats suite in initial checkpoint.
entries.live_shopify_closure: Pending; no ULTIMA Shopify deployment in this pass

entries.original_issue: Missing configurable section background and heading controls. Enhancement rather than confirmed defect.
entries.decision: Added optional section background, heading and subheading colors; project-card colors remain independent.
entries.verification: Cards/portfolio suite.
entries.live_shopify_closure: Pending; no ULTIMA Shopify deployment in this pass

entries.original_issue: Product-list handling incorrectly displays “No products found” despite populated collections or manually selected products.
entries.decision: Retain Shopify product-list drop and iterate for hero selection; explicit empty source no longer falls through to unrelated all-products collection.
entries.verification: Product feed/spotlight suite in initial checkpoint.
entries.live_shopify_closure: Pending; no ULTIMA Shopify deployment in this pass

entries.original_issue: Section upload rejected because a merge_mode option label exceeds Shopify's permitted length.
entries.decision: Shortened overlong merge-mode option label.
entries.verification: Theme Check and bundles suite.
entries.live_shopify_closure: Pending; no ULTIMA Shopify deployment in this pass

entries.original_issue: Optional homepage-only transparent header, changing to solid on scroll, developed in VANTIER. Evaluate for shared theme integration.
entries.decision: Optional homepage-only transparency, becoming solid on scroll or open navigation; default disabled.
entries.verification: Header lifecycle and source review; final visual/editor acceptance pending.
entries.live_shopify_closure: Pending; no ULTIMA Shopify deployment in this pass

entries.original_issue: Mobile imagery covers only about 230px of a 560px banner, leaving a large empty gray area.
entries.decision: Media fills its container; fade slides participate in layout so image/copy height is retained.
entries.verification: Mobile slide/fade browser geometry checks; shared source with #22, separate reproduction retained.

entries.original_issue: Pause button overlaps slideshow pagination dots; bottom-aligned content can collide with controls.
entries.decision: Mobile pause/dots separation and content clearance.
entries.verification: Transparent banner suite; actual long bottom-aligned copy preview acceptance pending.
entries.live_shopify_closure: Pending; no ULTIMA Shopify deployment in this pass

entries.decision: Parent-relative full width replaces viewport-width negative-margin calculation.
entries.verification: Scrollbar/overflow browser check.

not_theme_defects: Northstar NS-01–03, 07, 10, 14, 18–19, 21–22 are demo publication/content/palette/icon configuration issues per source report. NS-09 is preview-session interference. ORVAINE invalid settings/anchors/duplicate uploads and VANTIER chapter colors/encoding are configuration or operational issues, not generic core bugs.
deferred_capabilities: Fairway comparison/3D source limitations must be checked against current ULTIMA, which already has compare and frame-spin code; unavailable apps/catalog assets are not theme bugs. KINVAR Warehouse Merch homepage placement, Sale Highlight mobile heading controls, and Routine Finder grouped checkboxes remain capability/design backlog; not original 37 code defects.
